note: The script asks for three graphics: the hook text, the name card “Brandon” and one top text line about the prize. Every other row is captions only, and the end card is Freedom Reads' own.

mg.title: Reading was an escape
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1, top third: “Reading was an escape”. Cut on, no animation longer than 6 frames.
mg.use: Hook text in the top third, cut on at frame 1. Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:04.

mg.title: Brandon name card
mg.cue: Name card “Brandon” at 00:04–00:07, lower left, above the captions. First name only.
mg.use: Name card from 00:04 to 00:07. Move it lower left, above the captions.

mg.title: Prize judge line

text.main: Brandon is an Inside Literary Prize judge.

mg.cue: Top text, same style as the hook: “Brandon is an Inside Literary Prize judge.” On screen at least 3 seconds.
mg.use: Top text over the judges' group shot, in the same style as the hook. Keep it on for the whole row, at least 3 seconds.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: Freedom Reads logo. One line under it: “Inside Literary Prize 2026”. Then “Follow @freedombeginswithabook”. Dark text #292424. No captions.
mg.src: No Freedom Reads logo file found (only in older delivered cuts); the name is typed until James Davis sends it.
mg.use: This is the end card. Put it at 00:34 after the last line and hold it to the end.
